semiconductor_relevance: High — Toflo Corporation specializes in flow metering and control technologies that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Toflo Corporation manufactures flow metering equipment and control systems that enhance efficiency and quality in semiconductor processes. Their product offerings include flow controllers, flow control valves, and various flow meters, which are critical for precise fluid management in semiconductor fabrication.

regional_presence.China: Toflo Corporation has a representative office in Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor and environmental sectors.
